const byId = id => document.getElementById(id);
const set = (id, name, value) => byId(id).setAttribute(name, value);
function outline(values, tension = 1) {
  const points = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i += 2) points.push(values.slice(i,i+2));
  const count = points.length;
  let path = `M${points[0]}`;
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = points[(i+count-1)%count], b = points[i];
    const c = points[(i+1)%count], d = points[(i+2)%count];
    const first = b.map((v,j) => v+(c[j]-a[j])*tension/6);
    const second = c.map((v,j) => v-(d[j]-b[j])*tension/6);
    path += `C${first} ${second} ${c}`;
  }
  return path+'Z';
}
function normal(ax,ay,bx,by) {
  const length = Math.hypot(bx-ax,by-ay) || 1;
  return [-(by-ay)/length,(bx-ax)/length];

  const [sx,sy,ex,ey,wx,wy,angle,scale,curl,visible] = pose;
  const start = normal(sx,sy,ex,ey);
  const end = normal(ex,ey,wx,wy);
  const middle = normal(sx,sy,wx,wy);
  const edge = (x,y,n,r) => [x+n[0]*r,y+n[1]*r];
  const a = edge(sx,sy,start,width), b = edge(ex,ey,middle,width*.81), c = edge(wx,wy,end,4.5);

  const cap = [sx-(ex-sx)*.18,sy-(ey-sy)*.18];
  set(`arm-${side}-shape`,'d',`M${a} Q${a} ${halfway(a,b)} Q${b} ${halfway(b,c)} Q${c} ${c} L${d} Q${d} ${halfway(d,e)} Q${e} ${halfway(e,f)} Q${f} ${f} Q${cap} ${a}Z`);
  const gradient = byId(`arm-${side}-gold`);
  gradient.setAttribute('x1',ex);
  gradient.setAttribute('y1',ey);
  gradient.setAttribute('x2',wx);
  gradient.setAttribute('y2',wy);

  set(`open-eye-${side}`,'opacity',open);
  set(`open-eye-${side}`,'transform',`scale(1 ${.15+.85*open})`);

  render(t) {
    const time = ((t%5540)+5540)%5540;
    let i = 0;
    while (time >= times[i+1]) i++;
    const phase = (time-times[i])/(times[i+1]-times[i]);
    const blend = phase*phase*(3-2*phase);
    const pose = frames => {
      const a = frames[i], b = frames[(i+1)%frames.length];
      return a.map((v,j) => v+(b[j]-v)*blend);
